translationRepairs: Emperor Gaozu appointed Zhan to Wu Commandery, but Zhan petitioned again on his own behalf and was instead made administrator of Yuzhang.
Emperor Gaozu appointed Zhan to Wuxing Commandery, but Zhan petitioned again on his own behalf and was instead made administrator of Yuzhang.
Chinese 吳興郡 is Wuxing Commandery; rendering it as Wu Commandery (吳郡) drops 興 and names the wrong place. The proposed replacement restores the correct commandery name without other changes.
Emperor Gaozu appointed Zhan to Wu Commandery; he petitioned again on his own behalf and was then made Administrator of Yuzhang.
Emperor Gaozu appointed Zhan to Wuxing Commandery; he petitioned again on his own behalf and was then made Administrator of Yuzhang.
Same place-name error as the idiomatic: 吳興郡 must be Wuxing Commandery, not Wu Commandery; the repair corrects only that mistranslation.
He was sent out as administrator of Wu Commandery and was dismissed for official misconduct.
He was sent out as administrator of Wuxing Commandery and was dismissed for official misconduct.
出為吳興太守 names Wuxing, not Wu Commandery; 'Wu Commandery' omits 興 and confuses distinct commanderies. The replacement is accurate.
He went out as Administrator of Wu Commandery and was dismissed for official misconduct.
He went out as Administrator of Wuxing Commandery and was dismissed for official misconduct.
Literal likewise misreads 吳興太守 as Wu Commandery; Wuxing Commandery matches the Chinese, and the rest of the sentence is unchanged and correct.
He memorialized to impeach the minister of works Xu Xianzhi: "I have heard that serving superiors by upholding the law is respect, and governing subordinates with authority is order.

He memorialized to impeach the Director of the Imperial Secretariat Xu Xianzhi: "I have heard that serving superiors by upholding the law is respect, and governing subordinates with authority is order.
奏劾尚書令徐羨之 titles Xu as 尚書令 (Director of the Imperial Secretariat), not 司空 (Minister of Works). The repair corrects that office title only.

He memorialized to impeach the Minister of Works Xu Xianzhi, saying, "Your servant has heard that serving superiors with observance of statutes is respect, and facing subordinates with awe and dignity is order.

He memorialized to impeach the Director of the Imperial Secretariat Xu Xianzhi, saying, "Your servant has heard that serving superiors with observance of statutes is respect, and facing subordinates with awe and dignity is order.
Same office mistranslation in the literal: 尚書令 is Director of the Imperial Secretariat, not Minister of Works; the proposed wording is accurate and complete.
